learning_outcomes.text: Apply the five-step model to identify revenue from a contract with a customer
Identify distinct performance obligations within a contract
Determine and allocate the transaction price, including variable consideration
Decide whether revenue is recognised over time or at a point in time
Account for common features such as contract modifications, warranties and principal-versus-agent situations
Prepare the core disclosures that explain revenue to users

integrative_case: A software-and-services company sells a licence bundled with installation, a year of support and an upgrade right, sometimes at a discount and sometimes with usage-based fees; work through the five-step model to identify the performance obligations, allocate the price, decide the timing of recognition, and draft the revenue disclosures for the annual report.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
